tool.description: OWASP Amass v5 - attack surface mapping (subdomain enum, ASN). v5 MODEL: `amass enum` auto-starts a background engine (:4000) and writes results to a local asset DB — it does NOT print discovered names to stdout. Use the two-step `enum` then `amass subs -d DOMAIN -names` to get names. v4 flags -json/-o were removed from enum; -passive is now the default. For a quick stdout subdomain list prefer subfinder; use amass for active/brute + ASN/IP breadth.
tool.name: amass

options.label: enum - run enumeration (populates the asset DB)
subs - print discovered names from the DB
